title: Centralized Stream read-boundary settlement

benchmark_runs.quick_payload: raw and native Delimiter; 64 B, 4 KiB, 32 KiB and 200000 B; one warmup and three measured repeats
benchmark_runs.full_payload: raw and native Delimiter; all nine policy sizes; one warmup and five measured repeats, then one complete reverse-order retest
benchmark_runs.release: seven measured rotated repeats after warmup; all release workloads; focused quick Stream throughput runs also retained

configuration_note: Every payload JSON records effective Stream tuning, framer and delimiter, AF_UNIX transport, batching, read size/budget, buffer and queue limits, socket buffers/options, TLS state, concurrency, topology, reads, writes, callbacks, CPU and input peaks. The release JSON records resolved clients, messages, lifecycle iterations, pool, connections, warmups and workload order.
